title: REST API & Spring MVC
intro: REST API interview questions are core to every Java backend role — RESTful constraints, HTTP semantics and status codes, idempotency, request/response design, error handling, validation, pagination (cursor vs offset), HATEOAS, API versioning, OpenAPI/Swagger, HTTP clients (RestTemplate, WebClient, Feign), HTTP caching (ETag, Cache-Control), and Spring MVC controller fundamentals. For GraphQL-specific questions see the dedicated GraphQL page; for gRPC see the gRPC page.
